tagline: Read your mail. Keep your mail.

unified-inbox.headline: Read your mail. Keep your mail.
unified-inbox.sub: A full email client that files every message on your own disk as a plain .eml.

chat-view-chat.headline: Threads that read like a conversation
chat-view-chat.sub: Sent and received mail merged into one stream of bubbles.

archive-progress.headline: Clear the server without losing a thing
archive-progress.sub: Archive thousands of messages to the vault, then delete them from the server in one step.

local-vault.headline: Your mail, as plain files you own
local-vault.sub: Maildir and .eml, readable by Thunderbird, Apple Mail or grep. No lock-in.

premium-time-capsule.headline: Go back to any day in your mail
premium-time-capsule.sub: Point-in-time snapshots of the vault, kept on your schedule.

link-safety-modal.headline: See where a link really goes
link-safety-modal.sub: Both addresses shown before you open a link that does not match its text.
